payload.message: On account ACC-1011, settled TX-1002, GBP 26,000 Supplier invoice 2214, was not authorised by me. Please involve a human specialist and explain the next steps without promising recovery.

response.answer:
TX-1002 is eligible for an unauthorised-debit dispute. The deadline is 2026-10-28.

Before I open the dispute, which is irreversible, please confirm you want me to file it for the full GBP 26,000.00 under the "unauthorised debit" reason. Once you confirm, I will open it and hand the case to a human specialist as you requested.
